concept.title: People needing support at home
concept.shortdesc: Lonely or isolated people, those with housing needs and those wanting to live independently at home.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : People who feel lonely or socially isolated and could benefit from company, connection or support to reduce isolation.
: People looking for, struggling to keep, or at risk of losing a home, along with housing-related phrases such as landlords and residential properties.
: Adults, often older or with support needs, who want or need help to stay safely and independently in their own home.
